editorial:
Imagine living your dream life as a perfect housewife, posting pretty pictures for thousands of followers, and finally feeling safe after a rough past. That is exactly what you get with the main character in this thriller. You will feel the tension as she settles into this traditional lifestyle with her loving husband, but things take a turn when her mother disappears. The movie does a great job of making you feel that something is just a bit too perfect, which makes the mystery feel real and creepy. You will find yourself rooting for her and her sister as they try to figure out what is actually going on behind the scenes of this fake internet paradise.

The acting is solid and the plot moves along quickly without getting boring. While some of the twists might feel a bit predictable if you watch a lot of thrillers, the payoff is still satisfying. If you have a high-end setup, you should definitely stream this in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to catch all the detail in the beautiful house. Or, if you like owning your movies, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great call. It is a perfect pick for a movie night with friends who love a good mystery.
endingExplained: You will find out that the traditional community is actually a cult run by the husband. He uses the trad-wife image to trap women and control them. The missing mother was locked in a basement for speaking out. In the end, the main character and her sister fight back and manage to escape. The husband is arrested, and the fake online world crashes down, leaving the women finally free from his control.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves mystery movies about secret societies and social media.
